snippet.title: Eat the Rich Trailer - Release Date Announcement - Sept 10, 2025
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2234140/Eat_the_Rich/

Are you ready to fight for your lives, billionaires? Get ready to scheme, brawl, and deceive in a bid for wealth and fame!

Eat the Rich is releasing on September 10 in Early Access on Steam. 🎮
